connector.name: ThryxProtocol MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: ThryxProtocol v3.1 - gasless AI agent launchpad on Base. 21 tools wrap thryx.fun HTTP API.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lordbasilaiassistant-sudo account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: THRYX_API_KEY
env.description: Your THRYX API key (starts with thryx_). Get one for free with `curl -X POST https://thryx.fun/api/agent/register`. If unset, the package auto-registers a fresh wallet on first run and saves the key to ~/.thryx-mcp/credentials.json.

env.name: THRYX_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the launchpad base URL. Defaults to https://thryx.fun.
